packageMetadata.name: pele
packageMetadata.description: A fast, lightweight Mermaid renderer that outputs themeable SVG.
packageMetadata.author: kepano

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

artifact.deliveryScope: Per-file package gzip sizes are inventory, not observed network transfer or an npm tarball total.

sampling.order: rotate A0/A1/B by round and case; all warm jobs, then all cold jobs, then serial memory/baseline jobs
sampling.controls: A0/A1/B are the exact same admitted artifact, not three tool versions
sampling.caseAdmission: All selected cases remain in scope. A rejected family probe marks its cases unsupported. Invalid controls run once; cases failing or blocking admission retain their outcome but receive no further timing/resource jobs.
sampling.warmScope: Per-call means from batches bounded by minSampleMs or256calls; every distinct immutable SVG is checked outside clocks, byte-identical admitted returns reuse qualification; individual first-use samples are fresh processes
sampling.commentVariantScope: Trailing comment changes only source bytes, never semantic graph; this is a cache-key diagnostic
sampling.coldScope: Concurrent import preparation behind an idle barrier; one measured API call at a time and complete child exit before the next
sampling.memoryScope: Separate serial fresh processes; API snapshots precede qualification, GNU time describes the whole worker

unmeasuredScopes: Perceptual legibility, font metrics, text clipping and complete shape/path paint correspondence are not measured.

Graph checks cover owner identity, declared label ownership, edge count/endpoints, approximate attachment, ordinary directed markers or ER endpoint marker ink, and optional group containment. Crossings, full curve geometry, arbitrary transforms, unasserted class member/ER cardinality meaning and undeclared label-owner assignments remain unmeasured.

controls.method: Exact two-sided sign/order-statistic interval for the median round ratio; assumes independent representative rounds. No within-round call resampling.
controls.detail: A finite interval does not remove systematic host, workload or artifact differences.
